name: Supine Figure-Four Stretch
description: Cross one ankle over the opposite thigh while lying on the back to stretch the outer hip.

items.content: Lie on the back with knees bent and feet on the floor.
Place one ankle on the opposite thigh just above the knee, keeping the crossed foot gently flexed.
Hold behind the supporting thigh and draw it toward the chest until the outer hip stretches.
Keep the head and pelvis resting down; do not push on the crossed knee.
Breathe without forcing the stretch, release slowly, and switch sides.

stages.name: Hold
stages.description: Lying on the back with one ankle crossed above the opposite knee. Both hands hold behind the supporting thigh, drawing it toward the chest; head and pelvis rest on the floor.
